$comment: The hosts distill dispatches to, pinned per host version: the versioned binary (plan P2: the file itself, never a symlink an update moves), the flag set of each runner profile (its sha256 is what a receipt and a capture must carry; `wrappers/claude-run.sh` sends `hermetic` for `--use judge|authoring` and `hermetic-producing` for `--use producing`, whose manifest directory is hashed as `<manifest>`), and `context`, what the host loads by itself under a profile, which dispatch.py declares in every call's manifest (codex-cli 0.163.0's four built-in skills, as codex-run's capture records them by name: wrappers/codex_frame_filter.py, WP-04), and the auxiliary roles a host runs beside the declared seat (design §3.2 step 2, plan S-7). Read by runlib/gate.py (flag-set hash, auxiliary roles) and runlib/dispatch.py (pinned paths). An auxiliary role is accepted only in a call's closing aggregate, never as a main or child response, and for a live call only once `measured` is true (gate.auxiliary_models); a provisional entry serves replayed and golden captures. The request kind an auxiliary role serves is added by preflight (WP-23) together with the check that reads it. `stage_seats` pins each model stage's seats from design §4's stage table (the defaults a run may use without declaring them; run.json seats add to them), read by dispatch.py, which refuses a seat neither names for the call's stage. `host_allowance` is the host's own share of a view-window request, per host version and runner profile (input-bound amendment record 2026-10-21T0026--cc0498f--input-bound-amendment.md): preflight (WP-23) measures it; a slot preflight has not measured is unmeasured, and dispatch.py refuses a view-window call that needs it; the Claude hermetic slot was measured live in WP-03v.

auxiliary.basis: the author-side benchmark harness's retired auxiliary model list, which WP-17 retires in favour of this entry; preflight (WP-23) measures the roles per host version and replaces it

hermetic.basis: A-1 re-pin 2026-11-04 (WP-08 commit 6): observed main-request input tokens, max over 5 hermetic judge calls through dispatch (claude 2.1.317, claude-sonnet-5-5/high, stage S3, structured output; 3795, 3784, 3784, 3784, 3794); includes the packet, so it overstates the host's share. WP-03v measured 3886 the same way on 2.1.304 at /medium
unmeasured: preflight (WP-23) measures it per host version and flag set

stage_seats.$comment: design §4: S3 claude-sonnet-5-5/high (plan amendment row 13, D-20261103-4b967e); S4 claude-opus-5-5/high; S6 A claude-opus-5-5/high, B gpt-6-astra/xhigh, sweeps claude-sonnet-5-5/medium and gpt-6-luna/medium; S7 claude-opus-5-5/high; S7b gpt-6-astra/xhigh; S9b gpt-6-astra/high. S8 and S10b seat their actors from run.json actor_seats (design §8.4).

seat_capacity.$comment: The seat's context window, host-reported. A view-window call on a seat with no entry here is refused (CAPACITY_UNDECLARED): check (d) is about the context, and an invented capacity is a check about nothing. Codex seats carry no entry until a capture reports one.

claude:claude-sonnet-5-5/high.basis: host-reported modelUsage.contextWindow, A-1 re-pin 2026-11-04 (claude 2.1.317, claude-sonnet-5-5/high: one standalone hermetic call and five judge calls through dispatch, all 1000000; maxOutputTokens 128000 in the same records)

claude:claude-opus-5-5/high.basis: host catalogue, read 2026-11-06 for S4's bound (W review of WP-09 r1, F5): the model catalogue the installed claude caches under ~/.claude/cache/model-catalog gives claude-opus-5-5 runtime.max_input_tokens 1000000 (max_output_tokens 128000) in each of the three catalogue files that carry runtime, the freshest fetched 2026-11-06T01:08+09:00. The same catalogue gives claude-sonnet-5-5 1000000, which is that seat's measured modelUsage.contextWindow above. Not yet compared with a host-reported contextWindow of an opus call: the first live S4 call's result carries one.
